must_find.description: Configured npx file-bridge@latest is unpinned executable package resolution.
Lexical startswith permits sibling-prefix /srv/mcp-share-other paths; normpath without realpath also follows outside-target symlinks. Read-only root boundary is bypassable.
handle_line accepts write and opens path with w, despite the read-only consumer contract and readOnlyHint.
Access token is embedded in the launch config and inherited by launched package. Report redacted location; never reproduce the synthetic secret value.

guards.description: No HTTP/OAuth/Tasks/Apps here; do not impose HTTP audience/Origin middleware as missing stdio requirements.
Effective sandbox/egress/inherited credential scope/stop/audit protection remains host-owned unknown, not verified isolation or confirmed escape.
